title: Dev DASH/ Pod inactivated by itself
symptom: Pod becomes unreachable and suspends by itself. User gets a sound alert 'pod is unreachable' while phone is charging 5m from DASH. After muting, connection does not resume and refreshing pod status does nothing. User has to unsuspend pod manually.
cause: The connection was lost when setting a new basal rate. Updating basal rates for Dash involves suspend delivery then set new basal rate. Communication failed after the suspend step, leaving the pod suspended.
fix: The issue was closed after PR #984, which likely fixed the problem. No explicit workaround given in thread.
evidence_quote: I read the logs and it looks that the connection was lost when setting the new basal. That's why the pod ended up in a suspended state. The suspend worked, setting the new basal did not work.
